title: Your strength-3 arrays are used (and credited) in a planned ca-tools submission
body:
Hello Mickael,

Symbol fusion of some of your arrays from this repository, followed by deletion of redundant rows (for the first two with a tabu repair step), gives rows below the current ca-tools stair-step values:
- CA(6253;3,196,13) -> CA(6228;3,196,12), table 6340
- CA(6422;3,197,13) -> CA(6402;3,197,12), table 6563
- CA(19855;3,400,19) -> CA(19819;3,400,18), table 20189
- CA(20216;3,401,19) -> CA(20193;3,401,18), table 20573

I plan to credit these rows to you first, as "Mickael Bergeron (array, https://github.com/MichelBacon/covering-arrays-rms-extension commit 2c4edea); fused/post-optimised by Bai XunDi". They are listed in Table 4 of the preprint doi:10.5281/zenodo.23787053, and the arrays are at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23787055 (SHA-256 of each in SHA256SUMS). The first two fit the ca-tools pull-request check, and I plan to submit them in about two weeks; the other two have too many columns for it, and I am asking the maintainer how to submit them. If you would like a different form of credit, or would rather submit them yourself, please tell me before then.

How this was done: I directed the work, and Claude, an AI system from Anthropic, did the searches, computations and drafting, this issue included. Every array was checked exhaustively by a separately written checker, also run by Claude.

Bai XunDi (independent, no academic affiliation)
